Cam Cross
Partner,
Data & Analytics,Applied AI

Cam is a leader in West Monroe's Data & Analytics practice, where he heads Growth and Markets for Data and AI. Over 15+ years at the firm, he has helped multiple Fortune 50 healthcare companies turn data platforms into business impact. Today he focuses on the intersection of AI and data: agentic workflows, data accelerators, and the practical question of how data teams actually get more done.
Cam combines deep expertise in modern data platforms, AI, and enterprise architecture with a practical focus on delivering business value. He helps organizations operationalize emerging technologies including agentic AI, workflow automation, and has built multiple reusable data accelerators. Cam has experience advising and executing large-scale data platform modernization in multi-cloud environments across Fabric, Databricks, and Snowflake technologies along with various on-prem solutions including Cloudera, SQL Server, Oracle, IBM.
What makes Cam different
Cam lives in Chicago's North Center neighborhood with his wife Emily and their kids, Alden and Theo. They spend their time outdoors and traveling to state and national parks. He grew up in Woodstock, IL - best known as the town where Groundhog Day was filmed.
Where Cam makes an impact
Cam's team builds the tools behind West Monroe's data and AI work. Reach out for more on our application of agents and workflow orchestration in D&A: westmonroe.com/services/intellio-hopper
